title: box_scramble round input
description: Evaluation shape for one round. Unlike upstream Humanoid Parkour (static, public geometry), the box field ITSELF is drawn from `seed` inside the referee (env/course.sample_boxes) -- fixed box count and zone roles (100 scramble / 60 push / 36 climb), sampled size/density/placement. Each instance's wind is drawn from the same seed (env/sim.instance_spec), so the suite differs every round and the box field is identical across every instance within one round.

seed.description: Round seed: the whole box field (sizes, densities, placement) AND every instance's wind derive from it. One draw per round, fresh each round, so every instance in a round faces the identical field and the field rotates between rounds. Required rather than optional on purpose: a missing seed would silently freeze the box field instead of failing.

num_instances.description: Evaluation instances. Every instance in a round shares the identical box field; only wind varies between them, so this sets how well the suite covers the wind range and how much score noise the round carries -- inherited starting point from upstream parkour (24), NOT yet re-measured for this course's own score variance (see docs/design.md and HANDOFF.md SS4 before onboarding).

max_steps_per_episode.description: Control-step cap per instance (1 step = 20 ms sim time, so 3000 = 60 s). Inherited from upstream parkour's wall-clock sizing against a 900 s referee timeout; RE-MEASURE before onboarding, since box contact dynamics (196 free bodies) cost more per physics step than parkour's static geometry did. The referee's own time budget (`time_budget_s`) is what actually bounds the suite; this bounds one instance's simulated length.

deadline_ms.description: Per-/act deadline for the policy, enforced by the referee's HTTP client. Unchanged from upstream.

wind_max_ms.description: Upper bound of the per-instance wind draw, in m/s; speed is uniform on [0, this] and direction is uniform over the full circle. Default 8.0 (env/sim.WIND_MAX_MS) is Beaufort 4 at the robot, worth 3.6% of body weight in drag -- unchanged from upstream parkour. 0 disables wind. Tunable without a release, but it moves baseline_raw_score.

record_history.description: Write one replayable history file per instance to /data/history/, delivered to the miner as FileType.HISTORY. Optional and default-on; a write failure never affects the score.

history_stride.description: Keep every Nth control step in the history. Default 2 (25 Hz) via env/history.DEFAULT_STRIDE.

time_budget_s.description: Wall-clock seconds the whole instance suite may take, shared out equally across the instances still to run. An instance that reaches its share ends as `time_limit` and scores as a run that crossed no room; instances the budget never reached end the same way and stay in the mean. Must sit comfortably below `referee.timeout_s` in spec.yaml, which is a hard kill with no grace period. Default 780 (env referee DEFAULT_SUITE_BUDGET_S) against a 900 s referee timeout.
